Keyboard > Dictation displays whether processing requires Internet; enable Dictation and select Languages > Japanese (Japan). This guide is macOS26; actual host is macOS27.2.

Current macOS Golden Gate feature list includes Japanese (Japan) for on-device/modeless Dictation and states speech models must be downloaded. This does not prove legacy SFSpeechRecognizer assets are installed.

nextSafeSteps: Keep Keyboard Dictation enabled with Japanese (Japan) selected; provide a normal Internet connection so macOS can download speech models. Model download is distinct from sending benchmark audio.
Use the helper check button to recheck supportsOnDeviceRecognition, without starting audio recognition. Start 46 fixtures only when true.
No documented force-download command for the legacy SFSpeechRecognizer model was found in the consulted Apple pages. Do not install third-party asset files or change requiresOnDeviceRecognition.
If Settings still shows pending download, the benchmark remains blocked by OS-managed assets; do not score unavailable recognition as accuracy failure or superiority.
